purpose: Work still owed to the six-appearance icon system, written so it can be handed to Image Gen without re-deriving the evidence. Each entry names the object, the appearance, the evidence that fails it today, and what the redraw must produce.
rule: Nothing here may be repainted from another appearance's artwork. Every entry is redrawn from the named period evidence, then re-checked on the cross-era lineage board and the mixed-era check.

redraw.failure: All three ship a folder rotated into a standing three-quarter view. Every one of the three real systems draws the folder front-facing, wide, and filling its box; only the tab and a shallow lip carry depth.
redraw.brief: Redraw front-facing. Mac OS 9: periwinkle body, tab at top left, one-pixel dark keyline, hard offset shadow to the lower right, no rotation. Jaguar: pale sky blue, wide, soft Aqua sheen on the front face, subtle contact shadow. Snow Leopard: light steel blue, matte, restrained overhead key light, no gloss. In all three the folder must fill its box the way Apple's does instead of floating small inside it.

redraw.failure: The three OS X appearances draw a window. The semantic anchor asks for the target era's generic application container, and in every one of those systems that object is a sheet of paper carrying a pencil, a ruler and a brush.
redraw.brief: Redraw as the era's own generic application: paper with pencil, ruler and brush. Keep the era's material and lighting. The System 6 diamond-and-hand and the Mac OS 9 toolbox already follow their own prototypes and must not change.

redraw.failure: Jaguar ships a saturated blue drive where the captured Apple artwork is silver-grey. Snow Leopard and Yosemite ship an opened drive showing the platter and head arm; that reading also collapses into an unrecognisable grey blob at 16 px.
redraw.brief: Redraw as a closed drive body in all three. Jaguar: silver-grey, front-on, wide. Snow Leopard: brushed metal, restrained overhead key. Yosemite: flat light grey with a thin stroke. Compose the 16 px hint separately from a recognisable closed-box silhouette instead of reducing the large master.

redraw.failure: The shipped basket is electric blue. The captured Apple artwork is a graphite translucent wire basket.
redraw.brief: Redraw in graphite with translucent wire mesh and an Aqua highlight on the rim. Keep the empty and full states as one object.

redraw.failure: The object is a stack of paper in System 6 and Mac OS 9, a bound book in the three OS X appearances, and a page again in Tahoe. The bound-book form also collides with reader, which is already an open book.
redraw.brief: Settle on one identity across the row before redrawing. The finished long document is a squared block of paper, not a published book; reader keeps the book. Redraw the three OS X appearances as a thick, squared, bound-at-the-edge paper block in each era's material.

minorFix.failure: Jaguar adds a blue keyline, blue rules and a heavy violet shadow; Snow Leopard tints the page cream and adds a dark keyline; Yosemite adds a solid blue block no real system puts on a generic document; Tahoe has almost no contrast against a light desktop.
minorFix.brief: Every real generic document in these systems is a plain white page with a folded corner and no content. Remove the content and keylines, keep the page white, and give the Tahoe page enough edge contrast to survive on a light desktop.

minorFix.failure: Snow Leopard is shorter and flatter than Apple's tall chrome basket. Tahoe is a tall tapered tumbler with a dark teal interior and reads as a drinking glass.
minorFix.brief: Snow Leopard: raise the body and restore the chrome specular on the rim. Tahoe: widen the body toward a bin, keep the glass material, drop the dark interior.

minorFix.failure: The native ICN# is a hand holding a pen inside the diamond. The shipped hand has lost the pen and reads as a mitten.
minorFix.brief: Restore the pen in the hand as a smooth vector, keeping the diamond and the existing stroke weight.

minorFix.failure: The native ICN# 130 can is wider, has a full-width lid band drawn as two rules, and carries four ribs. The shipped can is narrower with a single lid rule and three ribs.
minorFix.brief: Widen the body toward the native proportion, draw the lid as a band rather than one line, and use four ribs. Keep the smooth vector treatment.

minorFix.failure: The face survives at 128 px but disappears at 16 px, where Yosemite reads as a white box with a blue square and Tahoe as a blue tile.
minorFix.brief: Compose the 16 px hint separately: drop the case detail and keep the two eyes and the smile as the whole icon.

evidenceMissing.need: Captured 10.10 artwork for the generic document, the generic application and the trash, at icon size rather than inside a Finder screenshot.
There is no shipped Tahoe 26 system to measure against in this repository. Every Liquid Glass judgement is currently taste, not evidence.
The captured Jaguar artwork covers five system objects. There is no captured reference for controlPanel, scrapbook, reader or the writing-route objects, so those stay product judgements.
